prompt: Create a tiny pixel-art app icon for the NYCC agent, an AI assistant for the New York City Council. No text or letters. Very few pixels, thick shapes, no thin lines, no windows, no steps detail, no gradients, no shading. Must stay readable at 20 screen pixels. Restrained academic identity matching a pixel logo of two interlocking speech bubbles.
processing: Removed border-connected cream background, cropped to the icon with a 4% margin, resized to 128x128 with nearest-neighbor. First attempt (detailed City Hall with a cross on the dome) was rejected as unreadable at 20px.
